content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses pakistan

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle offer rented infrastructure. You pay fees, accept their terms, and operate within their borders. They handle payment processing, product delivery, and customer management — until they don't. Sovereign commerce stacks like COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploy self-owned infrastructure. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store, Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, Supabase stores orders, and NOWPayments verifies crypto payments. You own the code, the data, and the process. No platform lock-in. No country restrictions. No sudden shutdowns.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe, PayPal, and their clones exclude countries based on financial risk, regulatory compliance, or political pressure. If your country is on their blacklist, you're locked out. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. They use globally accessible tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare, and Supabase. Payments are processed on-chain via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with no KYC. This isn't a workaround — it's a permanent structural alternative built at the base layer of the internet.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. They hold funds for days or weeks. NOWPayments charges 0.5% with no holding period. Payments confirm on-chain within minutes. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The real cost of sovereign infrastructure is deployment time and technical knowledge. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) handles deployment, configuration, and testing for you — delivering a fully operational store in 48 hours.
Stripe's country restrictions lock out 149 nations. Sovereign infrastructure has no borders.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Stripe-dependent platforms, you rent access. They own your customer data, payment history, and product delivery process. If they shut down or suspend your account, you lose everything. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership. Your store runs on your GitHub or Cloudflare account. Orders are stored in your Supabase database. Files are delivered from your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Automation is handled by your backend logic. COREMERCH deploys, tests, and hands off the keys — you own the infrastructure from day one.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're in a Stripe-supported country and value convenience over ownership, rented platforms might suffice — until they don't. If you're in Pakistan, Nigeria, or any restricted country, sovereign infrastructure is your only permanent solution. Choose this if you want to own your commerce stack, not rent it.
